[SWS_DM_01355] Consecutive registration of notifier with SetActivityNotifier()
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04169
⌈
In case of a consecutive call of
ara::diag::Conversation::SetActivityNo-
tifier
of the corresponding
ara::diag::Conversation
instance, DM module
shall overwrite the previous registered notifier.
⌋
